turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Absolutely. Quick reminder: third person singular takes -s (she works), -es after -sh, -ch, -s, -x, -o (he teaches, she goes), and -ies after a consonant + y (he studies).

Let's start with a spelling one: She ___ (watch) TV after dinner. Write only the verb.
